business_summary: Meidensha Corporation engages in the power infrastructure; public, industrial, and commercial sector; mobility and electrical components; field service engineering; and real estate businesses in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company provides vacuum circuit breakers and interrupters; high-voltage switchgears; transformers; mobile substations; zinc oxide blocks; surge arresters; turbine and engine generators; biomass power generation systems; and photovoltaic and hydroelectric power systems. It offers AC and DC power feeding systems for railways; regenerative power recovery systems; overhead catenary and inspection systems; high precision static overhead catenary systems; pantograph monitoring systems; power control systems; and wireless remote monitoring systems. In addition, the company provides power transmission and distribution systems; power generating systems; monitoring and control systems; cloud computing services for water suppliers and sewage treatment operators; membrane filtration system for drinking water treatment plant; automated water supply control and water distribution control support system; sewerage treatment process simulator; water quality measurement equipment; industrial wastewater treatment systems; and contract facility management services for water utility. Further, it offers ICT solutions; cloud service for facility maintenance; cloud computing services; motor and drive systems; semiconductor manufacturing equipment; communication systems; plant construction engineering; cold cathode X-ray tubes; automotive testing systems; electric vehicle drive systems; automatic guided vehicle systems; and facility management, maintenance, repair, junking, or renovation services. Meidensha Corporation was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
